jobs.title: Desktop UI final audit
jobs.prompt:
Read AGENTS.md and the current FocusLink UI diff. Audit desktop renderer changes for layout regressions, accessibility, breakpoint behavior, token consistency, and product-boundary violations. Do not edit files. Run focused read-only tests if useful. Return concise VERDICT / CHANGES / TESTS / RISKS / ARTIFACTS with exact file references.

Global job 1/5 (batch 1/1, local 1/5).
